title: Councilmember Campillo, SDPD, SDUSD Police Kick Off E-bike Public Education and Outreach Campaign
description: SAN DIEGO — Today, San Diego City Councilmember Raul Campillo was joined by the San Diego Police Department (SDPD), the San Diego Unified School District (SDUSD) Police Department, and local Girl Scouts troop 4343 to officially launch the City’s public education and outreach campaign on e-bike safety. The newly approved e-bike regulations impose an age limit of 12 years for class one and two e-bikes, essentially making a pedal bike the only bike approved for ages 12 and under. Class three e-bikes already require individuals to be 16 years or older to operate.
